summary: Persistent connection idle timeout defaults to 30 seconds; raise it with ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT or connect_timeout in [persistent_connection].
questions: How do I fix persistent connection idle timeout triggered?
How do I increase the network connection timeout?

answer_card.title: Increase persistent connection idle timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
export ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=60
```
or in `ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[persistent_connection]
connect_timeout = 60
```
Default is 30 seconds.
